items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I played there with Columbia Band, Tick Chambers. ... The drummer was with Tick Chambers by the name of Nene.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Johnny St. Sarah told me all the time.
Butcher Hill. Well, I played there with Columbia Band, Tick Chambers. I played in a fella's place. The drummer was with Tick Chambers by the name of Nene.
